title: Burnham vows to end existing pension triple lock in 2030 to help fund care
description: The PM was at times emotional during his conference speech in which he outlined his long-term plan for the UK.

title: Chris Mason: Burnham delivers deeply political speech with a personal core
description: The key thing to understand about Andy Burnham's speech is these were the words and the delivery of both a new prime minister and a grieving son, the BBC's political editor writes.

title: Man City guilty of 'sham' contracts and misleading accounts
description: The Premier League confirms that Manchester City have been found guilty of all charges related to breaches of Premier League financial rules between 2009-10 and 2017-18.

title: 'Quantity of petrol' but no explosives found in three vehicles near RAF Fairford
description: Police say the decision to release five men on bail is one "grounded in experience and strategy".

title: How did the RAF Fairford incident go from 'suspected bomb plot' to police bail?
description: Detectives are entering a vital stage of the investigation, with many of the public's questions unanswered, the BBC's Daniel Sandford writes.

title: Three teenagers die after car enters River Wear
description: The bodies of two teenage boys and a teenage girl have been recovered from the water, police say.

title: Watch: US journalist Evan Gershkovich describes being detained by Russian agents
description: He was arrested in Russia in 2023 and later sentenced to 16 years on espionage charges.

title: Eiffel Tower chief to quit after female staff replaced by men during religious visit
description: The company that runs the Eiffel Tower said the removal of female staff during the visit earlier this month was "unacceptable".

title: Prince William and Catherine's surprise visit to Kevin Sinfield's charity run
description: The rugby league star is on the third day of his endurance challenge to raise funds for Motor Neurone Disease charities.
